facts.fact: Mauritius Telecom's CEO says Kevin AI is the first model specifically designed to speak and understand Mauritian Creole, already in use by partner startups for automated bookings and for translating Creole interviews.
Mauritius Telecom's CEO says the operator is investing in local data centres equipped with GPU infrastructure to host sovereign AI applications locally.

systems.platform: Mauritian Creole voice and language model

systems.owner: Mauritius Telecom with Ministry of Education
